rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; ABIDE dataset collected at 17 data acquisition centers; ComBat harmonization applied for multisite effect correction
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "The ABIDE dataset is a large-scale open-access neuroimaging dataset for ASD, which currently includes resting-state fMRI data from 1495 individuals collected at 17 data acquisition centers."
rci1_using_msad.location: Jiang2024.pdf.md: Methods / Participants, L90-L92; S0033291724000138sup001.docx.md: Online supplement 1 Dataset details, L1-L3

rci2_using_epd.detail: ABIDE (Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange) used as the sole data source for both TD reference cohort and ASD cohort
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "All the data analyzed in this study were sourced from the ABIDE dataset"
rci2_using_epd.location: Jiang2024.pdf.md: Methods / Participants, L92; S0033291724000138sup001.docx.md: Online supplement 1 Dataset details, L1-L3

rci3_epd_name.detail: ABIDE-I dataset used; includes resting-state fMRI and behavioral data from 17 sites
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Using a world-wide multi-site database known as Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange"

rci5_n.detail: Overall TD cohort used for normative model construction; no explicit train/test split; entire TD sample serves as reference cohort; after exclusion of left-handed participants and those with poor scan quality from original 836 TD datasets
